purpose: Editorial fact-checking inventory. Planned means do not advertise as live; verify against current app and demos before marking shipped.

features.name: AI conversational shopping

features.name: Retailer research and price comparisons

features.name: Agent-assisted purchase and checkout

features.name: Order tracking and merchant checks

features.name: Returns assistance
features.notes: Distinguish guidance from successfully initiated return

features.name: Wardrobe and saved collections
features.notes: Describe UI and available behavior accurately

features.name: Personalized discovery and recommendations

features.name: Grocery lists and shopping tasks

features.notes: Clearly distinguish released and prototype surfaces
